_about: Mechanics only: how to do a remedy. Food and herbs are NOT here: a fast reads the foods, herbs and avoid list of its weekday's planet from the Ayurveda table (ayurveda_astrology.PLANET_AYURVEDA_FOODS), and how strict it is comes from the person's own constitution (Moon sign element) via fast_by_constitution below. Edit wording freely; keep it plain with no planet, book or method names. {day} is the weekday named in the remedy; {covers} is what that weekday stands for.

remedies.safety_plain: Skip the fast, or keep it very light, if you are unwell, pregnant, diabetic or on medication.

remedies.how_plain: Say it 11 times, slowly and out loud or under your breath, ideally at sunrise or before you start work.
remedies.for_plain: Steadies the mind and sharpens focus.

remedies.how_plain: Give a cow green fodder or a roti with jaggery, or contribute to a cow shelter.
remedies.when_plain: Any day; doing it regularly matters more than the day
remedies.for_plain: Eases the strain your year carries.

remedies.how_plain: Give it with your own hand, quietly, to someone who needs it, and do not tell anyone.
remedies.for_plain: Eases the strain your year carries.

fast_by_constitution.vata: Keep it gentle: warm water, herbal tea or a little fruit, and do not go long without something warm.
fast_by_constitution.pitta: Do not let hunger run past midday: take milk, coconut water or sweet fruit, and break the fast on time.
fast_by_constitution.kapha: A fuller fast suits you: water and light fruit until evening, then a simple meal.

fast_fallback_how: Eat lightly: skip your usual meals and keep to water, milk or fruit until evening, then break it with a simple meal.
